Voxframe 0.2.0 brings **the studio**: a place to finish your video, with the
player always in view, everything you can change beside it, and undo for every
change. It also brings better sound: voice polish, music fitted to the speaker,
and controls for how it all sits together. And it has a new look, in dark and
light.

Install this over 0.1.x: your library, videos and settings are kept.

![The studio, in dark mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ngum12/voxframe/v0.2.0/docs/images/studio-dark.png)

## Downloads

| | file | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Voxframe-0.2.0-Windows-setup.exe` | Not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen will ask you to confirm. [How to install](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/docs/install-windows.md) |
| **macOS (Apple Silicon) — early** | `Voxframe-0.2.0-macOS-arm64.dmg` | **Early build.** Unsigned, so macOS will ask you to confirm in System Settings. Apple Silicon Macs only. [How to open it](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/docs/install-mac.md) |

Check a download against `SHA256SUMS`, attached below.

Both downloads include FFmpeg 9.0.2, which is licensed under the GPL, as a
separate program. Its complete source is attached to this release
(`ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz`, with FFmpeg's signature `ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz.asc`), with
`ffmpeg-9.0.2-libraries.txt`: the libraries compiled into each build and where
their source is published.

## New: the studio

When your video is ready, it opens in the studio instead of a results page.

- **The video stays in view** while you work. Beside it are four tabs:
  - **Scenes:** change a scene's picture, use your own photo, turn the camera
    movement on or off, or add a title or chapter card;
  - **Captions:** click any word to jump to it, and correct what the captions
    say;
  - **Sound:** the voice, the music and how loud the video is;
  - **Style:** how the video was made, and its credits.
- **A timeline** under the video shows every scene, every word and the music.
  Click anywhere on it to go there, and zoom in or out.
- **See a change before you make it.** A new picture shows over the video
  straight away, marked "not yet in the video". When you're happy, click
  **Update video**: only what you changed is made again, and you stay in the
  studio while it happens.
- **Undo anything.** Ctrl+Z undoes your last change, whatever it was: a
  picture, a caption, a card or the sound. Ctrl+Shift+Z (or Ctrl+Y) redoes it.
- **Make room.** Fold away the side panel (`[`) or the timeline (`]`), or drag
  their edges to resize them. Voxframe remembers your layout.
- **Keyboard shortcuts.** Press `?` in the studio to see them all.

![The studio, in light mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ngum12/voxframe/v0.2.0/docs/images/studio-light.png)

## New: better sound

- **Voice polish**, on by default: gentle noise reduction, a clearer tone and
  an even level. It uses only FFmpeg's own filters and measures your
  recording first, so a quiet room is left alone. Switch to **Original** at
  any time to hear the recording exactly as it was.
- **Music fitted to the speaker.** Your own music track is now edited around
  your voice:
  - it's cut on the beat;
  - it drops under every sentence and rises into the pauses;
  - it ends exactly on your last word.
- **Add your own music at any time**, even after the video is made, from the
  Sound tab:
  - hear it under your voice before choosing it;
  - add a credit;
  - switch between it and no music, or remove it.
- **Sound controls:** the voice and music levels, how far the music drops while
  someone speaks, and where the video is going:
  - YouTube and social media: -14 LUFS;
  - WhatsApp: -15 LUFS;
  - podcasts: -16 LUFS.

  Moving a slider plays 15 seconds from where you paused. Applying a change
  remakes only the sound, so it's quick.
- **Every video's sound is checked:** its loudness, its peaks, the music
  staying under the voice, and clicks. If anything fails, the Sound tab says
  so.
- **Music already in your recording** is noticed. The Sound tab suggests
  leaving out added music, or warns that two layers may clash. The choice is
  yours.

The first time you use your own music track, the installed app downloads its
music tools once (about 90 MB, from PyPI) and shows the progress. Until then,
or if the download fails, the track plays as a simple loop under your voice.

## New: a new look

- **Dark and light.** Voxframe follows your computer's setting by default.
  Choose **Dark** or **Light** in **Settings → Appearance**.
- **A new start screen**, with your **recent videos**. Click one to open it in
  the studio.
- Every text and button colour meets the WCAG AA contrast standard, in both
  modes.

## Fixed and improved

- **Accented English was sometimes heard as another language.** Voxframe now
  listens for English and French only, the two languages it is tested in.
  This fixed a talk that the Lite models transcribed as Yoruba. Developers can
  set `VOXFRAME_LANGUAGES=any` to detect any language again.
- **Videos are named after your recording**, not "source", in the studio,
  in recent videos and in your Videos folder.

## If you're coming from 0.1.1

0.2.0 also includes the two Windows fixes from 0.1.2:

- **Long videos no longer fail at the very end** with *"The filename or
  extension is too long"*.
- **The installer waits for Voxframe to be closed** before updating it.
